purpose: 原创教学插画，不冒充设备照片或工程结构图。最初的 30 个物件由五张源图生成；现已抠出为独立透明 PNG 并清理相邻残片，网页不再裁切图集。新增独立物件的提示词见 single-object-prompts.json。

references.use: 参考物件、角色、科学视觉比喻和逐幕动画的制作方法；未复制其素材。

prompts.name: hardware
prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a production-ready transparent sprite sheet for an interactive university computer networking science animation. A single cohesive sheet, landscape 1536 by 1024, exact 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square 512x512 cells, no gutters drawn. Each cell contains ONE independent object centered, its complete silhouette within the middle 82% of the cell with clear empty margin. Consistent tasteful semi-realistic 3D editorial illustration, detailed physically recognizable objects, soft studio lighting from upper left, matte teal/navy/cream materials with warm amber accents, subtle ambient shadow, clean realistic proportions suitable for university students, not childish, not flat vector icons. All six cells independent on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, grid lines, colored panels, wires crossing cells, or background scene. Objects must not touch or overlap neighboring cells. Fixed slightly elevated three-quarter perspective, crisp rich surface detail. EXACT cell arrangement: top left an open silver laptop with a blank deep teal screen, keyboard and trackpad; top middle a compact dark gray rack server cabinet with three server units and small teal/amber status lights; top right a professional 24-port Ethernet network switch, realistic recognizable front sockets and status lights; bottom left a white wireless access point/router with two external upright antennas; bottom middle a modern smartphone upright in three-quarter view with a blank teal screen; bottom right an off-white wide rectangular satellite user antenna panel on a compact angled kickstand (flat panel, NOT a parabolic dish). No brand-specific claims.
